descripcion: Descripción del empleo NUESTRO PROGRAMA DE GRADUADOS Los participantes del Graduate Program estarán expuestos a los componentes fundamentales de las cadenas globales de valor de la agricultura y los alimentos. Nuestro programa está diseñado para brindar una base sólida para un rol comercial dentro del negocio de commodities, así como para identificar y desarrollar talentos con el deseo de convertirse en actores activos dentro de la compañía. A través de una combinación de capacitación estructurada, aprendizaje informal en el puesto, seguimientos periódicos y mentores inspiradores, los participantes conocerán diferentes áreas del negocio. Contribuirán a una variedad de proyectos, desarrollando las habilidades y la experiencia necesarias para una carrera diversa, desafiante y emocionante en LDC. OBJETIVO Y ESTRUCTURA Nuestro Graduate Program está diseñado para lanzar, acompañar y acelerar tu carrera profesional. El objetivo es ayudarte a desarrollar una comprensión amplia de la compañía y de sus diversas actividades, y brindarte oportunidades para construir una red de contactos en diferentes áreas. El Graduate Program de LDC consta de 3 fases : Fase 1 – Desarrollo de experiencia y habilidades de negocio Graduate Trainee por 12 a 18 meses Durante este período, trabajarás en distintas áreas de soporte, con foco en finanzas, controlling, planning y en toda la cadena administrativa financiera. Esto te permitirá comprender de manera integral cómo se gestionan los procesos clave del negocio, así como desarrollar una visión más completa del funcionamiento financiero de la compañía. Fase 2 – Incorporación a un rol permanente Al finalizar esta fase, si el desempeño es alto y existe una necesidad del negocio, el/la participante será confirmado/a en un rol permanente en nuestras oficinas de Buenos Aires. Como empresa global, ofrecemos la oportunidad de conocer y trabajar con personas de diversas culturas y orígenes en un entorno altamente atrayente. Fase 3 – Soporte y acompañamiento continuo Como parte del programa, vas a contar con iniciativas de desarrollo diferenciales, tanto en habilidades blandas como técnicas, que te permitirán estar mejor posicionado. De esta manera, una vez finalizada tu asignación, podrás seguir creciendo dentro de la compañía. ALCANCE DE LAS ROTACIONES Cada rotación cubrirá diferentes aspectos de nuestras operaciones globales, tales como: - Controlling - FP&A; - Ejecución Internacional - Contabilidad - SBS Requisitos Requisitos - Título universitario de grado o posgrado con especialización en Administración de Empresas, Contabilidad, Finanzas, Economía, Ingeniería o a fínes. Podrán aplicar al programa aquellos candidatos que estén próximos a finalizar la carrera y/o presentar su trabajo final. - Preferentemente contar con experiencia laboral o prácticas en un entorno corporativo. - Se espera aproximadamente 1 año de experiencia ; se valoran pasantías/prácticas en áreas contables, administrativas, financieras o de comercio exterior. - Inglés fluido es esencial. Se valorará el dominio profesional de otros idiomas - Fuerte enfoque emprendedor e innovador, pensamiento crítico, toma de decisiones sólida y capacidad de resolución de problemas - Alto potencial de liderazgo, espíritu competitivo y resiliencia - Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales; capacidad de negociación intercultural; actitud colaborativa y humilde - Capacidad para aportar al equipo y aprender de él, con muy buenas habilidades de comunicación interpersonal - Conocimientos en Python, SQL, Power Bi, manejo de datos es deseable - Disponibilidad para viajar y/o relocarse a lo largo del programa de manera temporal en Argentina. Información adicional El proceso de selección seguirá las siguientes etapas: - Revisión de postulaciones - Primer contacto y Entrevista virtual - Evaluaciones online - Evaluación de caso de negocio y entrevistas presenciales Que ofrecemos Un entorno multicultural, dinámico y desafiante, que ampliará y desarrollará sus capacidades y canalizará sus habilidades y experiencia con excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, en una de las companías mas sólidas a nivel global. Estos son algunos de nuestros beneficios: -Salario y Beneficios Competitivos. -Ambiente Laboral Flexible. -Accesos a Capacitaciones y Desarrollo. -Programa de Salud y Bienestar. -Licencia por Maternidad y Paternidad Extendida. Diversidad & Inclusión LDC se rige por un conjunto de valores compartidos, elevadas normas éticas, y la diversidad y la inclusión forman parte de nuestro ADN. LDC es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a proporcionar un entorno de trabajo que adopte y valore la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión. LDC fomenta la diversidad, apoya a las comunidades locales y las iniciativas medioambientales. Animamos a personas de todos los orígenes a presentar su candidatura. Sustentabilidad El valor sustentable está en el centro de nuestro propósito como empresa. Nos apasiona crear un valor justo y sustentable, tanto para nuestra empresa como para las demás partes interesadas de la cadena de valor: nuestra gente, nuestros socios comerciales, las comunidades con las que nos relacionamos y el medioambiente que nos rodea. descripcion: At AssistRx , we combine technology and talent to accelerate patient access to therapy. Our advanced hub solutions simplify the patient journey, connect prescribers, pharmacies, and manufacturers, and empower providers to make faster, data-driven decisions. Every day, our team uses data to bridge the gap between patients and the treatments they need. Join us, and be part of a company that transforms data into meaningful outcomes — ensuring that patients get on therapy, stay on therapy, and achieve better health. As a Data Insight Analyst , you'll play a key role in transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive smarter decisions across our organization and client base. You'll not only acquire, manage, and analyze data — you'll also help shape how our internal teams, clients, and partners understand and act on it. In this role, you'll lead electronic data partner onboarding, ensure smooth implementations, and act as the go-to expert for all things data quality. You'll collaborate across departments to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and strategic value — empowering stakeholders with the information they need to make a measurable impact. What You'll Do Transform Data into Insight: Develop reports, dashboards, and analytics using SQL, Tableau, Excel, and Salesforce data to reveal trends, relationships, and actionable business intelligence. Deliver Data Storytelling: Go beyond numbers by using visualizations and narrative context to explain findings and guide decisions. Ensure Data Excellence: Review and QA all data outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing with internal or external stakeholders. Be a Partner to Clients: Communicate directly with customers to understand their data needs, resolve quality issues, and meet key deadlines. Lead Implementations: Manage the onboarding and configuration of electronic data trading partners, ensuring a seamless setup and successful integration. Maintain Data Quality: Research, identify, and resolve data inconsistencies or anomalies; provide clear documentation and process improvements. Educate and Empower: Lead web-based training sessions with clients and partners on data specifications, helping them understand requirements and best practices. Be the Expert: Stay up to date on evolving data specifications and act as a trusted resource for both internal teams and clients Requirements Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field (Master's preferred). 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, data quality, or business intelligence role. Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or health-tech data environments highly preferred. Proven experience building dashboards and analytics in Tableau and Salesforce. Strong SQL and Excel skills required (advanced functions, queries, lookups, and automation techniques). Familiarity with ETL processes, data mapping, or partner onboarding preferred. Technical Skills Expertise in querying and manipulating large data sets using SQL and other BI tools. Proficiency in data visualization platforms such as Tableau (or comparable tools like Power BI). Understanding of data warehouses, data modeling, and data quality frameworks. Working knowledge of Salesforce reporting and data integrations a plus. Ability to translate business questions into data-driven analyses. Professional Attributes Self-starter who takes initiative and ownership of projects. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills — especially in translating data into clear insights. Client-facing professionalism with the ability to manage multiple stakeholder priorities. Thrives in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and evolving environment. descripcion: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. The goal of our Content Management & Distribution Data Science and Engineering team is to enable operational and creative excellence in the distribution and promotion of our content on our service. We collaborate closely with our partners in the Product Discovery & Promotion organization, and our work directly contributes to launching high-quality content on our service and helps our members discover content they will love. We conduct analyses, build analytical tools, and develop models to help our partners execute on these primary objectives. We are looking for a talented Research Scientist to join our Merchandising & Content Understanding pod, which focuses on deepening our content metadata across all formats and improving the discovery experience on our service. You will design and develop models and conduct quality evaluations for algorithms that will power the next generation of capabilities for our business. You will partner with our world-class team of creative production practitioners and various cross-functional teams to shape strategy and deliver impact via machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions. Interested? Read more about the job description and qualifications below! What You Will Do Collaborate closely with stakeholders in Product Discovery & Promotion to learn deeply about content metadata and merchandising and identify potentially impactful problems to solve via scalable machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions Develop innovative systems and models that empower decision-making for stakeholders and product features that can deliver member joy by leveraging a wide variety of metadata and production media generated by and collected from our productions throughout their end-to-end lifecycle Collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners to operationalize your models so that they can be integrated seamlessly into operational workflows Serve as a key thought partner for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and our diverse set of team members regarding machine learning algorithms and system architectures Your Background And Characteristics Ph.D. or MS degree in a quantitative or computational field 4+ years of full-time work experience in one or more relevant machine-learning roles Practical experience in supervised, unsupervised, and deep machine learning methods Practical experience applying machine learning and Gen AI solutions to video, audio, and/or textual data sources, and developing quality evaluations via mechanisms such as LLM-as-a-judge or LLM juries Practical experience operationalizing or productionizing machine learning and/or artificial intelligence solutions Comfortable and effective in ambiguous problem spaces; ability to own and drive projects with minimal oversight and process Exceptional written and oral communication with technical and non-technical audiences Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled. Show more Show less

descripcion: CD Baby is a globally recognized leader in the music industry and the first platform to offer artists direct distribution to their fans. As we navigate the next era of music technology, we are committed to modernizing our core systems, fostering an agile culture, and leveraging cutting-edge platforms to better serve our artists, partners, and fans worldwide. This hybrid role can be based in our Los Angeles (preferably), Nashville, or New York City office location. The Role: As Director of Business Intelligence, you will define and own the strategy and roadmap for making data accessible, trusted, and actionable across CD Baby. You’ll establish the metrics that matter most, drive data normalization across teams, and build the infrastructure that enables self-service insights at scale. You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Finance, Data Engineering and stakeholders across the company to prioritize the highest-impact KPIs, ensure consistent definitions across the organization, and embed data into how decisions get made. This role is both strategic and hands-on: you’ll architect the BI function while also building dashboards, leading analyses, and translating complex data into clear business recommendations. What you'll be doing: Define the BI Strategy & Roadmap Establish a company-wide BI vision and multi-quarter roadmap. Standardize core metrics and KPIs across business, product and technology teams Prioritize the highest-impact insights that drive growth, retention, and artist success Build scalable reporting layers and self-service infrastructure that reduce ad hoc dependency Evaluate and deploy AI-enabled analytics tools that scale insight generation and reduce dependency on manual reporting Drive Customer & Product Insights Lead segmentation, cohort analysis, lifetime value modeling, and churn analysis. Identify growth opportunities, at-risk artists, and high-value segments. Define and measure success metrics for new product and feature launches. Support experimentation and A/B testing with rigorous statistical analysis Build Data Analytics Infrastructure Partner with Data Engineering to continuously improve data quality, modeling, and governance Ensure reliable, well-documented reporting pipelines in cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) Translate complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives Implement natural language and AI-assisted query tools that allow non-technical stakeholders to explore data and answer questions independently Must-Haves / Requirements: 7+ years of experience in data analytics, customer insights, business intelligence, or a related field Advanced SQL; experience with modern BI tools and cloud warehouses Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in enterprise BI tools Strong foundation in customer analytics (segmentation, LTV, churn, experimentation) Familiarity with SaaS or platform metrics (ARR, CAC, LTV, retention) preferred Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and communicate clearly at all levels CAREER DEVELOPMENT / EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, CD Baby does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of sex, age, race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, genetic information, veteran status or disability. descripcion: Title: Senior Services Advisor Position Overview The Solution Advisory Group (SAG) Consultant is responsible for enabling commercially sound, accurate, and standardized scoping and estimation activities that support both software implementations and post-implementation service requests. This role works closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Professional Services delivery teams to translate customer requirements into clearly defined scopes, effort estimates, and Statements of Work (SOWs), ensuring alignment of expectations, reduced delivery risk, and efficient execution. Note: Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Job Responsibilities Implementation Pre-Sales and Scoping Receive and analyze implementation requirements from the Sales organization, assessing products, workflows, regulatory considerations, and country-specific technical constraints. Validate and confirm customer requirements within a clearly defined functional and technical scope, identifying dependencies, constraints, risks, and success-critical elements. Translate Sales Engineering scope definitions into clear, accurate, and commercially viable project proposals. Prepare detailed effort and cost estimates, broken down by products, roles (including Project Management and technical teams), special activities, and hours, leveraging best practices and lessons learned from previous projects. Identify, document, and validate assumptions, dependencies, and considerations to be included in Statements of Work (SOWs). Ensure SOWs clearly define scope, deliverables, responsibilities, exclusions, and service conditions, aligned with approved estimates. Service Request Estimation Serve as the single point of intake and evaluation for estimation requests related to changes on implemented products. Provide timely, high-level effort and cost estimates to support rapid customer response and efficient approval processes. Ensure estimation accuracy by leveraging historical data, comparable use cases, and prior implementations. Maintain clear scope definitions to reduce ambiguity, rework, and downstream delivery disputes. Support hour consumption management by providing reliable estimates for approved service requests. Standardization and Continuous Improvement Promote standardization of analysis, estimation, and documentation processes across implementations and service requests. Contribute to continuous improvement of templates, estimation criteria, and best practices to increase accuracy, efficiency, and quality. Apply a pragmatic, experience-based approach to estimation, avoiding unnecessary deep technical analysis during the pre-sales and estimation phases. Collaboration and Communication Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, Project Managers, and Professional Services delivery teams to align expectations and ensure smooth project transitions. Provide clear and regular updates to internal stakeholders regarding scope, assumptions, and estimation outcomes. Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and commitment to personal development; develop strategies to balance automation with appropriate human escalation paths. Organizational Alignment Reports to: Senior Manager, Services Advisory Skills Required Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. Professional proficiency in English (written and verbal). Experience in a software or professional services environment, preferably supporting enterprise or compliance-related solutions. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business and technical requirements into clear scopes and estimates. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and priorities effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational, time management, and decision-making capabilities. Comfortable working with enterprise and Fortune **** customers. Nice to Have Knowledge of SUT concepts and processes. Experience working with Salesforce (CRM usage for opportunity, scoping, or services-related workflows). Environmental Job Requirement Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues, and internal stakeholders. Comprehend, structure, and communicate complex functional and technical concepts. Analyze requirements, identify risks, and propose sound estimation approaches. Leverage technology (laptop, collaboration tools, cloud platforms) to fulfill work requirements. Company Background Sovos was built to solve the complexities of the digital transformation of tax, with complete, connected offerings for tax determination, continuous transaction control compliance, tax reporting and more. The company supports more than 8,000 customers, including half of the Fortune 500, operating in over 70 countries. Its SaaS products and proprietary Sovos S1 Platform integrate with a wide variety of business applications and government compliance processes. Sovos has employees throughout North America, Latin America and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter. #J--Ljbffr Buscojobs

descripcion: Position Summary: The Industrial Engineer – Operational Excellence supports our nationwide pallet‑pooling operations by driving process improvements, optimizing performance, and strengthening our culture of safety and continuous improvement. This role combines industrial engineering expertise with Lean methodologies to enhance operational efficiency and promote safe work practices throughout our network. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, the ability to influence across all organizational levels, and a hands‑on approach to implementing sustainable improvements in fast‑paced operational environments. Essential Functions: Industrial Engineering & Process Optimization Perform time studies, workflow evaluations, and capacity analyses to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities. Develop engineered labor standards, process documentation, facility layout recommendations, and labor/capacity models. Analyze operational data to identify trends, constraints, and cost‑saving opportunities. Implement and maintain visual factory tools that support performance management, safe operations, and clear communication at facilities. Create process maps, standard work documentation, and operation‑level performance dashboards. Lean & Continuous Improvement Lead and facilitate Lean initiatives, including Kaizen events, 5S activities, standardization efforts, PDCA cycles, and waste elimination projects. Train and coach teams on Lean tools and best practices to build organizational capability. Partner with leadership to sustain Lean practices and ensure alignment with organizational goals and operational standards. Safety Support & Risk Reduction Conduct safety‑focused process reviews to identify ergonomic risks, material‑flow hazards, and environmental/operational safety issues. Collaborate with site leaders to integrate safety considerations into process design, layout changes, equipment usage, and standard work. Support safety improvement initiatives such as hazard assessments, job‑safety analyses (JSAs), and near‑miss root‑cause reviews. Assist in developing visual safety systems, including signage, floor markings, traffic‑flow visuals, and standardized safety communication boards. Partner with operations teams to reinforce safe behaviors, promote a culture of hazard awareness, and drive compliance with company safety expectations. Participate in safety audits, facility walkthroughs, and data reviews to identify and resolve potential safety concerns. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Renter, and Supply Chain teams to address operational challenges and implement scalable solutions. Build productive working relationships with site leadership to ensure consistency and alignment with company performance, safety, and sustainability initiatives. Serve as a resource for Lean methodologies, process engineering, and continuous improvement tools. Other Responsibilities Maintain timely, professional communication with internal and external partners. Uphold company values and contribute to a culture centered on safety, respect, integrity, and operational excellence. Perform other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skill & Abilities Strong understanding of Lean principles and industrial engineering methodologies. Proven ability to conduct time studies, process modeling, and workflow redesign. Experience analyzing data and converting insights into actionable recommendations. Familiarity with safety program concepts such as hazard assessments, ergonomic evaluations, or safety risk mitigation (preferred but not required). Experience developing or supporting visual factory systems is a plus. CAD drawing proficiency Proficiency with Microsoft Office ( Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio; Access/Project a plus). Statics Black Belt equivalent knowledge Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities across a multi‑site operational environment. Key Competencies for Success Safety Focus – Models and reinforces safe behaviors; proactively identifies hazards and improves safety outcomes. Continuous Improvement – Seeks opportunities to eliminate waste, optimize processes, and deliver sustainable results. Collaboration – Works effectively with cross‑functional teams and builds strong relationships across the network. Analytical Thinking – Applies data‑driven analysis and structured methodologies to solve complex problems. Accountability – Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently delivers high‑quality work. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field. 3–5 years of experience in industrial engineering, continuous improvement, or Lean within logistics, warehousing, or manufacturing. Environment/Physical Demands: Work may take place in production, yard, and warehouse environments, including exposure to outdoor conditions and forklift traffic. Travel: 50%-75% travel required to support site operations, improvement initiatives, training, and safety reviews. Show more Show less

descripcion: Locus Robotics is a global leader in warehouse automation, delivering unmatched flexibility and unlimited throughput, and actionable intelligence to optimize operations. Powered by LocusONE, an AI-driven platform, our advanced autonomous mobile robots seamlessly integrate into existing warehouse environments to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and scale operations with ease. Trusted by over 150 industry leading retail, healthcare, 3PL, and industrial brands in over 350 sites worldwide, Locus enables warehouse operators to achieve rapid ROI, minimize labor costs, and continuously improve productivity. Our industry-first Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model ensures ongoing innovation, scalability, and cost-effectiveness without the burden of significant capital investments. With proven capabilities in diverse workflows—from picking and replenishment to sorting and pack-out—Locus Robotics empowers businesses to meet peak demands and adapt to ever-changing operational needs. We are seeking an Industrial Engineer with a successful track record of continuous process improvement/optimization practices in distribution, warehouses, eCommerce, 3PL type environments. This role ensures that our nationwide sites experience initial and continued top productivity performances achieved by optimizing customers KPIs, processes and designs relative to an automated picking operation. This includes data analysis, knowledge in re-mapping floor plan layouts or specified areas and presenting details of process improvement to key stakeholders including our customers, Operation Managers, and Operation Supervisors. Internal company interaction with Customer Success Managers, Deployment/Integration team members, Robotic Support Engineers and Engineering included. 50% US travel, additional percentage during Peak Season . Responsibilities Prepare detailed analytical reports on key performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement around the Locus Robotics picking operations. Identify and improve linkages between data points. Interpret and transform data into meaningful information that can be acted upon. Use Voice of the Customer as well as onsite direct observations to provide recommendations on processes improvements and optimization to maximize the robots' efficiency and picking productivity. Work with the internal team to implement such recommendations. Work on post-sales solutions design efforts around locus operation layout design and tote design. Collaborate with the sales team to understand initial requirements. Work with the customer to identify the best optimal solution from a layout standpoint. Develop or enhance tools and methodology to support the optimization process across multiple customers. Use Voice of the Customer to provide feedback back to engineering around new product features or enhancement of existing ones. Interact with a variety of customers, including 3PLs, retail, e-commerce, automotive and life science. Communicate and present to different customers stakeholders, including corporate executives and site operators. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering or equivalent: Operations Management, Supply Chain Management/Lean Process Improvement Management. 3+ years of experience in distribution or logistics operations, preferably e-commerce/fulfillment and 3PL. 3+ years of data analytics experience. Prior experience with automation and solution design (AMR, Robotics, Conveyors). Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI and PowerPoint. Prior experience with AutoCAD for fulfillment centers/warehouses. Proficient in developing process flows, fishbone diagrams, and conducting why-why analysis. Attention to details and analytical thinking. Demonstrated ability to work in fast paced environments- multiple projects concurrently and prioritize projects to meet deadlines. Demonstrated ability to work and communicate with multiple customers and stakeholders from different backgrounds and levels. Entrepreneurial, ownership mindset and integrity. Thrives in a "hands-on" role actively engaged in operations management. 50% travel with increased travel during Peak season. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions. descripcion: About Otto Aerospace Otto Aerospace is developing the world’s first fifth-generation business jet, designed for sustainability through the innovative use of advanced super-laminar aerodynamics and high-precision, net-shaped composites. Flight tests of our technology demonstrator validate a dramatic reduction in fuel burn and allow a sizeable improvement in cabin comfort. Otto Aerospace is designing world-class aircraft from first principles physics and delivering ground-breaking aircraft and economic performance. About The Role We are seeking a proactive and analytical Lead Industrial Engineer to support the modeling, simulation, and optimization of our aircraft production environment using Dassault Systèmes DELMIA within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. This role plays a critical part in ensuring our factory layout, resource allocation, and process flows are digitally validated and aligned to operational targets before physical implementation. The ideal candidate has a background in Industrial Engineering, experience with discrete-event or 3D simulation tools, and is excited to help design a next-generation aerospace factory from the ground up. What You’ll Do Produce and maintain capacity models and production ramp plans to define labor planning, capex requirements, workstation design, and throughput gaps Design effective facility layouts and production lines using CAD and simulation which meet process requirements, enable production targets, optimize resource allocation and material flow, and maximize production along with quality Work with cross-functional teams (Manufacturing, Facilities, and Design Engineering) to translate product and process data into simulation-ready workflows Identify and champion improvements to key causes of high variability or production bottlenecks, driving actions to resolution across disciplines and stakeholders Generate reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings and support capital decision-making Leverage data-driven approach to production design and process improvements to improve throughput Collaborate with the Digital Thread team to maintain traceability between MBOM, process plan, and plant simulation Continuously refine simulation models as designs, layouts, and schedules evolve Ensure all processes comply with industry regulations and safety standards Contribute to the development of the Industrial Engineering team by establishing and standardizing internal tools and processes, mentoring and training associate team members, while promoting a collaborative and productive work environment. Who You Are Education Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering or similar Engineering degree Experience 5-7 years of relevant experience in industrial engineering, factory simulation, digital manufacturing, or similar Hands-on experience with 3DEXPERIENCE / DELMIA, particularly Process Engineer, Ergonomics, Plant Simulation Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret MBOMs, process plans, layout drawings, and ERP/MES data Working knowledge of lean principles, takt time planning, and value stream mapping Demonstrated ability to measurably improve production metrics, such as cost, yield, and throughput Understanding of the requirements of manufacturing systems, process, and organizations to enable scalable production Excellent collaboration and communication skills to coordinate across functions Preferred Experience: Experience supporting factory launch or greenfield site development Familiarity with discrete-event simulation, ergonomic analysis, and layout optimization tools Exposure to aircraft assembly, composite manufacturing, or highly complex production environments Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within iterative design-build cycles while facing fast-paced development timelines Where You'll Be This role will initially be remote with 25% travel to our temporary facility at Meacham Airport in Fort Worth, TX. Once our new headquarters in Jacksonville, FL is ready for occupancy, the role will transition to onsite at that location (6-18 months) Benefits Otto Aerospace provides a robust benefits package that includes competitive salaries, subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) opportunities, paid short-term disability, voluntary long-term disability and additional term life, with 15 paid days off, 15 paid holidays, and paid sick leave. Depending on seniority and role, some roles qualify for potential bonuses and stock options. You’ll help standardize best practices across co-manufacturers and warehouse partners, ensuring consistency and replicability as we expand. The mission to protect the firm, its reputation, and deliver the highest quality standards of security is a continuous endeavor. Join a global team of over 1100+ security professionals who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting the global firm and its client information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team help protect the EY brand and build client trust. The opportunity Leading a highly effective, mature Global Information Security Program requires a constant focus on continuous improvement. Information Security is a cornerstone of any modern business, and a dedicated Program Improvement team is essential for driving ongoing success. The Integral Lead for Information Security Program Improvement is responsible for leading a team of professionals focused on enhancing the Information Security Program through service management maturity assessments, process improvement analysis, customer experience measurements, and the planning of strategic initiatives to promote continuous improvement in the Program. As the Program Improvement Leader, you will oversee a team of IT Service Management (ITSM) professionals responsible for managing the framework for service management related to EY's security services. This role demands a deep understanding of ITSM best practices, process re-engineering, and effective team leadership. descripcion: **ÚNETE A LA MISIÓN DE AMGEN DE SERVIR A LOS PACIENTES** En Amgen si te sientes parte de algo más notable es porque lo eres. Nuestra misión compartida: servir a pacientes que viven con enfermedades graves, impulsa todo lo que hacemos. Desde 1980, hemos ayudado a ser pioneros en el mundo de la biotecnología en nuestra lucha contra las enfermedades más graves del mundo. Con nuestro enfoque en cuatro áreas terapéuticas -Oncología, Inflamación, Medicina General y Enfermedades Raras - llegamos a millones de pacientes cada año. Como miembro del equipo de Amgen, ayudará a generar un impacto duradero en las vidas de los pacientes mientras investigamos, fabricamos y entregamos medicamentos innovadores para ayudar a las personas a vivir vidas más largas y felices. Nuestra cultura galardonada es colaborativa, innovadora y basada en la ciencia. Si te apasionan los desafíos y las oportunidades que se presentan en ellos, prosperará como parte del equipo de Amgen. Únete a nosotros y transforma las vidas de los pacientes mientras transformas tu carrera. Es momento de que tengas esa carrera de la que puedas estar orgulloso. ¡Únete a la familia Amgen! **Supply Chain Distribution Manager** El rol será responsable de garantizar la importación, distribución y almacenamiento de los productos de Amgen dentro de los plazos requeridos, cumpliendo con los más altos estándares de Compliance, calidad y buenas prácticas de distribución y documentación. Además, liderará e impulsará proyectos de innovación y mejora continua relacionados con procesos de importación, distribución, almacenamiento y optimización de costos, asegurando la eficiencia y sostenibilidad de la cadena de suministro. **Entre sus responsabilidades, se destacan**: - Supervisar las operaciones de importación, incluyendo la gestión del despachante de aduanas y agente de cargas, la revisión de contratos con proveedores, el monitoreo de KPIs y el asesoramiento continuo en comercio exterior para otras áreas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de Compliance y calidad en distribución de Amgen. - Creación, mantenimiento, supervisión y actualización de los planes de distribución. - Gestionar la relación con el proveedor de servicios logísticos, supervisando operaciones diarias y asegurando el cumplimiento de normativas internas, externas y estándares de calidad (Compliance, SLA, KPIs), brindando soporte en urgencias y asignación de recursos en situaciones críticas. - Garantizar el almacenamiento adecuado de productos, la integridad del inventario y la ejecución de controles, ajustes y reportes requeridos. - Coordinar envíos al laboratorio de control de calidad y gestionar devoluciones junto con Customer Service y el Proveedor de Servicios Logísticos. - Manejo de la operación de distribución de los productos en todo el territorio nacional. - Liderar proyectos de mejora e innovación en procesos de distribución, almacenamiento y optimización de costos. - Supervisar gastos y presupuesto, así como la elaboración y actualización de procedimientos, instructivos y reportes. - Brindar soporte en auditorías y entrenar al personal del proveedor cuando sea necesario. - Garantizar el cumplimiento de las buenas prácticas mediante la gestión de CAPAs, desvíos y controles de cambio, asegurando que todas las actividades se realicen conforme a procedimientos por personal calificado, manteniendo la actualización de documentación y deteniendo cualquier operación ante dudas de calidad o seguridad. - Asegurar que el entrenamiento inicial y continúo requerido del departamento y el personal es realizado y actualizado de acuerdo con la necesidad. **Lo que esperamos de ti** **Requisitos básicos**: - Título universitario en Licenciatura en Comercio Exterior, Administración de Empresas, Contabilidad, Logística o Ingeniería Industrial. - Mínimo 5 de experiência en puestos de Comercio Exterior y/o Distribución y Logística, con excelente conocimiento en las normativas globales de Comercio Exterior, procesos de importación y distribución de productos en Argentina. - Experiência en manejo de proveedores 3PL/4PL. - Inglés fluido, tanto verbal, como escrito **Calificaciones deseadas** - Experiência en el relacionamiento con proveedores de servicios de aduana (despachantes) y/u operadores logísticos y con manejo de proveedores de logística. - Manejo avanzado de herramientas de Excel, Microsoft Office, ERP y de visualización de datos. - Experiência en la gestión directa de personas y/o experiência liderando equipos, proyectos, programas o dirigiendo la asignación de recursos. - descripcion: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. This data scientist role will focus on characterizing the quality of experience specific to our nascent cloud games offering, and operationalizing it across the business to illuminate and drive prioritization against the highest impact opportunities. You will join the team of Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers who partner with our infrastructure engineering teams to create metrics, perform analysis, and develop the tools and data products that help us make better decisions about our infrastructure and its impact on our product’s quality of experience. What You’ll Do Establish the fundamental set of quality of experience metrics used to evaluate our Cloud Games sessions, which is likely to include research and development of several new metrics. Become the resident expert on all things Cloud Games Quality of Experience, partnering closely with Games Engineering and Games Studio teams to drive a culture of data-informed decision-making about our games title portfolio and the games platform infrastructure. Develop deep expertise in how the Cloud Games infrastructure works, and understand how data, analytics, experimentation, and algorithms can play an impactful role in driving improvements to its performance. Use a combination of experiment and observational data to understand the Netflix member perspective on their gaming experiences. Help us understand the Netflix member perspective on their experiences. Translate valuable insights and data from this domain to initiatives in other parts of the business. You Have Advanced training in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Economics, etc) or commensurate work experience. Fluent in SQL. Comfortable prototyping pipelines of moderate complexity, with the ability to effectively partner with data engineering teams building more scalable solutions for important use cases Strong Quantitative Programming skills in Python, R experience a plus Passion for instrumenting and analyzing products to drive improvements to user experience, backed by strong product knowledge and intuition - ideally utilized in consumer/user interface settings or internally serving technical audiences such as engineers. Demonstrated effectiveness at developing meaningful stakeholder relationships and deep domain expertise. The demonstrated ability to communicate technical and statistical concepts clearly and concisely among audiences at many different levels. Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to thrive with minimal oversight and process. Embodied the Netflix values while bringing a new perspective to continue improving our culture. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $372,000.00 - $600,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Has a good understanding about how other channels work and optimise together. Is a confident, dynamic, engaging and authentic communicator who is able to lead client communication. descripcion: Job Accountabilities Company Overview CROWN Cork & Seal USA, Inc., a wholly owned company of Crown Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in the design, manufacture and sale of packaging products for consumer goods. At Crown, we are passionate about helping our customers build their brands and connect with consumers around the world. We do this by delivering innovative packaging that offers significant value for brand owners, retailers and consumers alike. With operations in 39 countries employing approximately 25,000 people and net sales of approximately $12 billion , we are uniquely positioned to bring best practices in quality and manufacturing to our customers to drive their businesses locally and globally. Sustaining a leadership position requires us to build a team of highly talented, dedicated and driven individuals. Division Crown’s Food Division is a premier manufacturer of food cans and ends. Our complete array of food packaging serves a variety of markets, including fruit, vegetables, dairy, fish, meat, ready meals, pet food, infant milk powder and other dry food products. We offer a wide selection of food cans from round to bowl as well as shaped cans. We truly focus on excellence. Here is your chance to join the Crown Food Business Unit. Location: Ideal candidate will reside near a major airport in the Midwest and/or Eastern Region of the US as this position will require up to 70% regular travel to the Plant locations. Position Overview The Manufacturing Engineering (with an Electrical Engineering emphasis) will support eight (8) facilities of the North American Food Division manufacturing operations. This position will work closely with the manufacturing facilities in regard to electrical programming, problem solving, etc. for both the 3-Piece and 2-Piece steel and aluminum food cans and end processes. Duties And Responsibilities Reporting directly to the Sr Manager Production Engineering (Electrical) duties would include but not be limited to the following: Providing problem-solving on electrical technical matters relating to food can and end performance Developing full documentation package of new and existing installations Continued support of new installations and plants until production efficiencies and goals are met Support plants and personnel as required to identify production problems or issues, identify viable solutions and implement the same Develop job completion schedules and monitor their progress Guide, support and train plant electrical teams Job Requirements Qualifications In addition to the specific responsibilities listed above, the ideal candidate will possess the following: Minimum Requirements BS degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or a related discipline 5+ years in a packaging manufacturing environment, food production or a similar industry. Strong technical knowledge demonstrating broad understanding of electrical power and controls design and installation Demonstrated experience in PLC logic programming, documentation, and troubleshooting control programs (Allen Bradley, Siemens, Modicon, etc.) Experience with facilities power distribution (including voltages to 600v & three phase) and control systems and subsystems Power transmission equipment such as gearboxes, drive trains, conveying equipment, etc. Proven record of delivering engineering outputs to achieve scheduled targets Effective communication skills are needed for this role, both verbal and written as well as the ability to interact with employees at all levels of the organization. Self-motivated and eager to take the initiative; with the ability to work effectively in a team setting and as an individual Well organized and detail oriented with good time management skills Strong PC skills are a must, especially using Word, Outlook, and Excel. Committed to on-going personal development and career growth Preferred Requirements Steel and/or aluminum manufacturing environment experience would be ideal A certification in Six Sigma and/or Lean Manufacturing would be a plus Physical Requirements While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands, reach with hands and arms, and may be required to balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl The associate may lift and/or move up to 50 pounds Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus Working Conditions Will be required to perform job duties outside of the typical office setting in a plant environment as well as in an office. While performing the duties of this job, the associate may be exposed to moving mechanical parts and vehicular traffic. The associate may be exposed to a wide range of temperatures. The noise level is frequently loud. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Show more Show less

descripcion: Overview Our client is looking for a highly experienced Customer Supply Chain Manager to take ownership of end-to-end logistics, retail operations, and inventory flow across US and EU markets for a growing consumer business. This is a hands-on, high-impact role focused on stabilising and optimising existing operations, reducing costs, and building scalable systems. The position will evolve from an initial deep operational dive into a lighter, strategic oversight role. Key Responsibilities Warehouse & Logistics Management (US + EU) Own relationships with third-party logistics (3PL) partners across the US and EU Audit and approve warehouse invoices, identifying discrepancies and overbilling Improve billing structures and enforce commercial terms Optimise shipping costs, packaging, and carrier selection Monitor inventory movement and reduce inefficiencies in stock flow Negotiate improved rates with logistics and freight partners Oversee international shipping and distribution setup Retail Operations (Primary: Major US Retailer) Own end-to-end retail operations via EDI/ADI systems Ensure accurate order processing, invoicing, and payment reconciliation Monitor, manage, and resolve chargebacks and compliance issues Track and reconcile retailer payments and cash flow discrepancies Maintain retailer relationships and operational cadence (e.g. weekly check-ins) Ensure adherence to retailer-specific operational requirements Marketplace & Channel Coordination Coordinate with marketplace partners and agencies (e.g. Amazon) on inventory and replenishment Align stock levels with demand forecasts Support wholesale and dropship order flows Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and sales support Inventory Planning & International Freight Partner with finance to forecast inventory requirements Plan purchasing and replenishment based on demand and lead times Manage inbound and outbound freight logistics Oversee shipping documentation and customs processes Source cost-effective freight solutions E-commerce & Dropship Oversight Oversee existing dropship workflows and identify inefficiencies Support operational consistency across direct-to-consumer channels Recommend automation and system improvements where appropriate Process Optimisation & Cost Reduction Identify inefficiencies across all operational areas Implement systems, SOPs, and controls to improve performance Drive measurable cost savings across logistics and operations Stabilise fragmented or inconsistent workflows Team Transition & Handover Document processes and build operational playbooks Support hiring or development of a junior operations resource Transition day-to-day execution once systems are stabilised Requirements Who you are: Background 6-10 years' experience in operations, supply chain, or logistics Experience in both direct-to-consumer (DTC) and wholesale/retail environments Hands-on experience working with major retailers (EDI, compliance, chargebacks) Strong familiarity with 3PL warehouse management and freight logistics Core Skills Strong cost control mindset with the ability to identify inefficiencies quickly Deep understanding of shipping, packaging, and carrier pricing Confident managing external partners and challenging where needed Experience with multi-region inventory planning Comfortable operating in imperfect or evolving systems Retail & Systems Experience Experience with EDI/ADI systems and retailer workflows Marketplace coordination (e.g. Amazon or similar platforms) Understanding of e-commerce platforms (e.g. Shopify) and dropship models Experience handling chargebacks and retailer disputes Working Style Independent and decisive Structured and process-driven Comfortable with ambiguity and building from incomplete systems Focused on solving problems and driving improvement (not maintaining status quo) Role Structure & Time Commitment Phase 1: Stabilisation (First 2 Months) 15-25 hours per week Deep operational dive across logistics, retail ops, and inventory Focus on fixing core issues and establishing control Phase 2: Optimisation (Month 3) :10 hours per week Improve margins, negotiate contracts, and document processes Phase 3: Ongoing Oversight :5 hours per week Support team transition and provide strategic oversight Success Metrics Reduction in warehouse and shipping costs Improved invoice accuracy and cost visibility Decrease in chargebacks and operational errors Stronger inventory turnover and availability Stable, documented processes ready for delegation What This Role Is Not Not a junior or entry-level operations role Not a purely executional position Not a long-term full-time hire at this stage Benefits This role is a remote, fractional contractor opportunity, and we need someone who can start immediately. descripcion: **Descripción del Puesto/de la Posición** Esta posición funge como facilitador e integrador fundamental de la información recopilada de diversas fuentes, diseña herramientas de visualización para ayudar a analizar e interpretar toda la data significativa e identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y tendencias de mercado, y con esto poder soportar la toma de decisiones de cada cliente, así como también para la planificación y ejecución presupuestal. **Responsabilidades** Es responsable de todas las actividades de 2 grandes áreas: Market Intelligence y Data and Analytics (DnA) and Business Intelligence. Business Intelligence: - Asegurar el seguimiento de los lineamientos globales de SFE y SIP en tiempo y forma. - Liderar la interpretación de resultados a través de las diversas auditorias con las que contamos mediante una sólida colaboración con los especialistas y analistas. - Liderar el equipo de Business Intelligence para la ejecución de los procesos estratégicos relacionados a las áreas a cargo, analizado la data del mercado, identificando oportunidades y riesgos de la compañía de manera que se puedan coordinar los indicadores de gestión para la fuerza de ventas, garantizando la eficiencia comercial de los equipos involucrados. - Elaborar insights precisos para la adecuada gestión de los equipos de ventas, comercial, marketing, finanzas y dirección general. - Consolidar la información través del desarrollo de metodologías y procesos para el análisis en campo, informes y revisiones periódicas para respaldar las estrategias locales del negocio. - Identificar y definir nuevas oportunidades de mejora en los procesos comerciales. - Desarrollar y mantener una base de datos sostenible y confiable para contar con un One-Source-of-Data, manteniendo informado al equipo de liderazgo, regional y global para entender las oportunidades de crecimiento. - Crear soluciones de visualización de datos estandarizadas, que generen informes para el equipo ejecutivo, tales como Dashboards periódicos con indicadores clave (%Crec, MS, IE). - Administrar los gastos de las auditorias y servicios contratados con terceiros. - Administrar del Budget para pago de incentivos al equipo de ventas. Market Intelligence y Data and Analytics (DnA) - Producir conocimiento de cliente a partir de la gestión de punta a punta desde el diseño de la investigación, ejecución, o supervisión del tercero, análisis e interpretación integral, con el fin de comunicar los hallazgos estratégicos al negocio para guiar y sustentar las tomas de decisiones y ejecuciones de estrategias de marketing. - Diseñar las metodologías adecuadas para utilizar mejor los conocimientos de los clientes y la investigación de mercados primaria y secundaria. - Apoyar al equipo de ventas, marketing y comercial brindando recomendaciones de la tendencia de mercados monitoreadas. - Colaborar con equipos cross functional para llevar a cabo análisis profundos de las tendencias de venta de nuestros productos y la competencia, de tal forma que esta información sea base para la toma de decisiones rápida y efectiva. - Conducir innovación y diferenciación a través de soluciones de análisis de data. - Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento acelerado del negocio basado en la inteligencia recopilada y la comprensión del mercado. - Desarrollar análisis de precios y volumen para respaldar las decisiones del equipo comercial. Detalle de actividades Business Intelligence: - Administrar el call deck, a través del monitoreo de la herramienta CRM Veeva, dando gestión en los procesos del día a día, dando seguimiento al soporte de fuerza de ventas, levantando tickets, asegurado ejecución de los change request, y corroborando los cambios realizados. - Diseño y ejecución periódica ejercicios de Targeting y Segmentación para asegurar tener el call deck con los clientes más potenciales para nuestros productos en promoción. - Análisis periódico de los call deck en el CRM, así como la cuota-venta a nível distrital, territorio y brick/estado. - Coordinación del proceso de entrega de Muestra Médica y Materiales Promocionales para la Fuerza de ventas, y HCPs, gestionando que los materiales sean entregados en función a las estrategias de marketing, tomando en cuenta el análisis de especialidad y categoría de nuestro call deck. - Generación de KPIs de seguimiento a Fuerza de Ventas y equipo comercial (cobertura de visitas, promedio diario de visitas, frecuencia, secuencia, etc). - Diseño e implementación de reportes ejecutivos para la toma de decisiones precisas (coaching, visitas acompañadas, seguimiento de eventos, tablero para BRs, etc). - Gestión del Plan de Incentivos, asegurando la constante motivación de fuerza de ventas para alcanzar y rebasar los objetivos mensuales. - Coordinar el liderazgo de proyectos y los entrenamientos para la ejecución de planes y objetivos globales y locales. descripcion: OverviewWhy should you join dLocal? dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world's fastest-growing, emerging markets.By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with ****+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people's daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.The Manager – SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting will play a key role within the Finance organization, leading the group's external financial reporting under IFRS and U.S. SEC requirements. This position has end-to-end ownership of SEC reporting, group consolidation, disclosure quality, and internal controls over financial reporting, while also providing technical accounting support on complex transactions. What will you be doing? SEC Reporting & External Financial Statements Lead the preparation, coordination, review, and filing of Form 20-F and Form 6-K, ensuring compliance with SEC regulations and IFRS. Own and manage the full SEC reporting calendar, ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality filings. Review consolidated financial statements, notes, and disclosures under IFRS. Ensure consistency across consolidated financials, SEC filings, management reporting, and investor-facing materials. Partner closely with Legal, Investor Relations, and external advisors on disclosure matters. Internal Controls & Governance Own and maintain effective Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) within the SEC reporting and consolidation scope. Design, document, and continuously improve reporting and consolidation controls, policies, and procedures. Support internal and external audits, including coordination with auditors and remediation of findings. Process Improvement & Automation Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, and data quality issues across consolidation and reporting activities. Lead automation and standardization initiatives in collaboration with Finance Systems and IT teams. Drive scalable solutions to support business growth and increasing reporting complexity. IFRS Technical Accounting Support the assessment of accounting treatment for complex or non-routine transactions impacting consolidated financial statements and disclosures. Contribute to the maintenance and interpretation of group accounting policies, ensuring alignment with IFRS and external reporting requirements. What skills do I need? Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Strong experience in SEC reporting, including Form 20-F and Form 6-K. Hands-on experience with group consolidation in a multinational environment. Solid understanding of IFRS financial statements and disclosure requirements. Experience working with internal controls over financial reporting. Certified Accountant (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent). Strong technical expertise in SEC reporting and consolidation. High attention to detail with a strong ownership mindset. Ability to manage complex timelines and multiple stakeholders. Clear, structured, and effective communication skills. Continuous improvement mindset with a strong focus on automation and scalability. What do we offer? descripcion: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. As a Senior Data Scientist focused on Infrastructure Availability, you will join a data org of Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists who partner with our infrastructure engineering teams to create metrics, build tools, perform analyses and make recommendations on how to improve the reliability and availability of our systems using data. You will work closely with partners in data science, software engineering, performance engineering and technical product management to develop metrics to assess current performance across systems and product domains, define what adequate performance looks like, understand the root causes of availability issues, and make recommendations for how the business should prioritize system performance improvements. The ideal candidate will excel in metric research & development, statistical modeling, causal inference, and share a passion for continuously improving the way we use data to make the Netflix infrastructure better. To learn more about our team, read here. In This Role, You Will Develop metrics to measure the availability, reliability and performance of Netflix’s infra stack Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science and Analytics Engineers to productionize system level availability metrics and dashboards Partner with Software Engineers, Performance Engineers, Technical Product Managers and other product teams to conduct root cause and causal inference analysis of availability issues and make recommendations for how to remediate Connect with the larger analytics community at Netflix to bring more visibility to our work. You Are Experienced in metric development and measurement in the domain of system reliability / availability for large, distributed systems, platforms, and/or infrastructure Fluent in at least one analytics and scripting language like Python. Experienced in engineering data pipelines and ETL in languages like SQL and workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow. Passionate about using data to help guide strategic decision making. An exceptional communicator with both technical and non-technical audiences. Experienced at telling stories with data and communicating to stakeholders at all levels of the business. Experienced in building strong relationships with stakeholders and colleagues to tackle big, cross-functional problems. Comfortable with ambiguity, and thrive with minimal oversight and process. A strong product thinker with good product sense: you know how to get at what our partners need and how to develop solutions to satisfy those needs. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $372,000.00 - $600,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled. Show more Show less

descripcion: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. The Title and Launch Management (TLM) team is responsible for building and innovating the technology foundations that enable the ingest, setup, launch, and global distribution of all types of entertainment on Netflix—including series, movies, games, ads, live events, trailers, and more. TLM acts as the bridge between the title creation lifecycle and the consumer experience, ensuring that launching titles on Netflix is efficient, flexible, accurate, and scalable. Our team’s goal is to make launching titles as seamless as possible, supporting both operational and creative needs across the company. The Core Catalog team within TLM owns the catalog and the associated backend services and front end tools to onboard new content to Netflix at scale. The team is building innovative solutions to onboard new content types such as linear and domains beyond movies. This is a full stack team and its offerings are highly impactful to the business. As Netflix onboards more content types and a variety of content partners, this team will experiment and iterate to design, deploy, and integrate AI-powered solutions to address a wide range of launch needs. Qualifications Experience crafting resilient, high-scale, low-latency microservices in production environments. Proficiency with gRPC, GraphQL, or RESTful API design and implementation using OO programming languages like Java, C#. Adept at building enterprise applications with HTML/JavaScript/TypeScript/CSS. We currently build our user experiences with React, GraphQL, and several more libraries and frameworks depending on the product. A proven track record of resilient data modeling through understanding and translating business requirements to technical requirements and identifying entities and their relationships that will serve the business process needs. Experience participating in on-call rotation and leading incident reviews. What Sets You Apart Experience working and building enterprise tools for a video streaming business. You demonstrate strong communication skills and are comfortable driving conversations with cross-functional partners. You are comfortable operating in highly ambiguous situations in a fast paced environment. You operate with an AI first mindset and are able to propose AI forward solutions to solve business problems. You can operate effectively through the full-stack. You evangelize new ideas and exemplify technical leadership with a bias for action. You are comfortable asking questions and seeking knowledge in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $250,000.00 - $413,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled. Show more Show less
